description: Firewall rule permits unrestricted inbound SSH traffic (port 22) from public internet (0.0.0.0/0).
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-FW-99201: Firewall rule allow-ssh-ingress permits unrestricted ingress port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0.

factors: Affects inbound traffic routing for 8 production backend nodes
Public exposure to active automated botnet scanning
risk_assessment.rationale: Direct public SSH ingress on production VPC exposes critical backend infrastructure to brute force and protocol exploits. Requires immediate gating and remediation.

proposed_state.description: Restricted SSH ingress via Google Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP)

technical_diff.summary: Restricts SSH ingress strictly to Google Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy tunnel.

remediation.action_title: Restrict Inbound SSH Rule to Google Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) CIDR
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 3.6 mandates blocking 0.0.0.0/0 SSH. Google Cloud IAP (35.235.240.0/20) enforces contextual IAM authentication without public exposure.

steps: Fetch cached firewall snapshot from metadata store
Re-apply original source ranges using compute.firewalls.update API

description: GKE cluster master authorized networks permits unrestricted public access (0.0.0.0/0).
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-GKE-30192: GKE cluster payments-gke-prod has control plane exposed to public internet.

factors: Affects control plane of primary production transaction cluster
Kubernetes API server reachable by arbitrary internet addresses
risk_assessment.rationale: An exposed Kubernetes API server allows unauthorized probes and credential stuffing against cluster RBAC. Restricting authorized networks isolates the master control plane.

technical_diff.summary: Restricts master authorized CIDRs to internal bastion subnet and enables private endpoint.

remediation.action_title: Restrict GKE Master Authorized Networks to Corporate Bastion Subnet
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 4.1 requires disabling 0.0.0.0/0 access on GKE master control plane to prevent reconnaissance and cluster-takeover attacks.

steps: Query cluster master authorized networks snapshot
Revert via container.clusters.update API if management connectivity is broken

description: Cloud SQL instance exposes public IPv4 address with authorized network 0.0.0.0/0.
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-SQL-77102: Cloud SQL instance customer-db-pg-prod has public IP enabled with unrestricted ingress.

factors: Direct exposure of PCI customer cardholder relational database
Permits ingress on PostgreSQL TCP port 5432 from all internet hosts
risk_assessment.rationale: Public IP on core production relational database violates PCI-DSS 1.3 and CIS GCP 6.2. Enforcing Private Service Access (PSA) isolates DB within private VPC.

technical_diff.summary: Revokes public IPv4, clears 0.0.0.0/0 authorized network, binds Private Service Access.

remediation.action_title: Revoke Public IPv4 & Attach Private Service Access (PSA) on Cloud SQL
remediation.rationale: Eliminates internet attack surface for PostgreSQL instance while retaining low-latency private connectivity for application pods.

steps: Check connectivity on private IP range
If client disconnect threshold exceeded, rollback IP configuration via sql.instances.patch

description: BigQuery dataset access list grants READER role to allAuthenticatedUsers group.
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-BQ-89102: BigQuery dataset customer_churn shared with allAuthenticatedUsers.

factors: Confidential business dataset exposed to any authenticated Google identity globally
Severe regulatory non-compliance under GDPR and CCPA
risk_assessment.rationale: Sharing datasets with allAuthenticatedUsers allows external third-party Google accounts to query company warehouse tables without enterprise authentication.

technical_diff.summary: Revokes public allAuthenticatedUsers; scopes access to verified enterprise analyst group.

remediation.action_title: Revoke allAuthenticatedUsers from BigQuery Dataset Access Control List
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 7.1 prohibits public dataset sharing. Restricts access to enterprise Google Workspace group.

steps: Revert dataset ACL using bigquery.datasets.patch API

description: Batch processing service account possesses primitive project-wide roles/owner role binding.
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-IAM-5102: Service account etl-batch-sa possesses excessive roles/owner permissions.

factors: Service account holds primitive Owner rights across production project
High blast radius: potential to delete or modify any project asset
risk_assessment.rationale: Primitive roles violate least privilege. If the service account credentials are compromised, an attacker gains root-level administrative access to the entire production analytics project.

technical_diff.summary: Removes primitive roles/owner; assigns fine-grained, least-privilege roles determined via IAM recommender.

remediation.action_title: Downgrade Primitive roles/owner to Scoped Least-Privilege IAM Roles
remediation.rationale: Aligns with CIS GCP Benchmark 1.4 by removing dangerous administrative capabilities while preserving ETL execution permissions.

steps: Re-grant roles/owner binding via gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding if jobs fail

description: Internal payment processor microservice permits unauthenticated invocation by allUsers.
prompt: Restrict unauthenticated invocations on internal Cloud Run service payment-processor-service.

factors: Payment microservice callable by anonymous web requests
Bypasses API Gateway rate limiting and authentication checks
risk_assessment.rationale: An unauthenticated Cloud Run endpoint processing credit card payments presents an imminent fraud and abuse risk. Must enforce OIDC identity verification.

technical_diff.summary: Revokes anonymous public invoker; restricts to verified API Gateway service account.

remediation.action_title: Revoke allUsers Invoker IAM Role & Enforce Authenticated Invocations
remediation.rationale: Restricts invocation rights to authenticated upstream API gateway, preventing direct anonymous HTTP execution.

steps: Re-add allUsers to roles/run.invoker binding if upstream token signing fails

description: Cloud Storage bucket financial-audit-logs-prod is missing Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMEK).
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-GCS-91823: Cloud Storage bucket financial-audit-logs-prod is missing CMEK encryption key.

factors: Financial regulatory audit trail must satisfy SOX & PCI key management controls
Bucket currently protected only by Google-managed keys
risk_assessment.rationale: Financial audit logs stored with default Google-managed keys do not provide cryptographic sovereignty or granular key destruction capabilities.

technical_diff.deletions:
- encryption: Google-Managed Default Key
- default_kms_key_name: null
technical_diff.summary: Enforces Cloud KMS Customer-Managed Encryption Key as default for new object uploads.

remediation.action_title: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMEK) via Cloud KMS
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 5.3 mandates customer-managed keys for regulatory audit buckets, granting the enterprise full cryptographic lifecycle control.

steps: Clear default_kms_key_name on bucket metadata via storage.buckets.patch

description: GKE production cluster has public master endpoint and disabled intra-cluster network policy enforcement.
prompt: Remediate finding group on GKE cluster payments-gke-prod (2 active high/critical violations).

factors: Overlapping multi-issue finding on single high-criticality cluster asset
Master endpoint exposed plus flat, unsegmented pod network topology
risk_assessment.rationale: Combined attack surface: external attackers can probe control plane, and internal pod breaches can move laterally without Calico network policies.

technical_diff.summary: Restricts master API server to bastion CIDR and enables Calico network policy enforcement.

remediation.action_title: Atomic Multi-Finding Remediation: Restrict Master CIDR & Enforce Network Policy
remediation.rationale: Single atomic plan remediates both CIS 4.1 and CIS 4.6 under a single verified change window.

steps: Revert cluster configuration snapshot via container API

description: Cloud KMS symmetric encryption key payment-kek has automatic rotation disabled in production.
prompt: Enable 90-day automatic cryptographic key rotation on Cloud KMS key payment-kek.

factors: Key encrypts primary production payment credentials and database records
risk_assessment.rationale: Keys used indefinitely accumulate massive volumes of ciphertext under a single key version, magnifying exposure in case of cryptanalytic compromise.

technical_diff.summary: Enforces 90-day automatic cryptographic key rotation period.

remediation.action_title: Configure 90-Day Automatic Key Rotation on Cloud KMS CryptoKey
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 1.10 mandates scheduled key rotation to protect downstream encrypted databases and buckets.

steps: Clear rotation schedule via kms.cryptoKeys.patch API

description: Production MySQL instance permits unencrypted SSL connections and has automated backups disabled.
prompt: Remediate finding group on Cloud SQL instance orders-mysql-prod (SSL and Backup disabled).

factors: Overlapping multi-finding: unencrypted traffic in-transit & lack of DR backups
risk_assessment.rationale: Allows man-in-the-middle sniffing of order data in-transit, and risks irrecoverable data loss without daily snapshots.

technical_diff.additions:
+ ssl_mode: ENCRYPTED_ONLY
+ backup_configuration: { enabled: true, start_time: "02:00" }
technical_diff.summary: Mandates TLS encryption on DB port 3306 and enables nightly automated snapshots.

remediation.action_title: Enforce SSL-Only Connections & Enable Automated Daily Backups on Cloud SQL
remediation.rationale: Satisfies CIS GCP 6.4 and 6.7 simultaneously, securing data in-transit and disaster recovery readiness.

steps: Revert SSL mode via sql.instances.patch

description: Production payment secret stripe-live-api-key lacks Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMEK).
prompt: Enforce Cloud KMS CMEK encryption on Secret Manager secret stripe-live-api-key.

risk_assessment.rationale: High-value production payment keys stored without customer-managed cryptographic keys fail compliance mandates for key isolation.

technical_diff.summary: Attaches Cloud KMS CMEK key to secret replication config.

remediation.action_title: Enforce CMEK Encryption on Secret Manager Secret
remediation.rationale: Enforces sovereign customer encryption key on sensitive payment gateway credentials.

steps: Revert secret encryption configuration

description: GKE cluster workload identity is disabled; pods utilize static long-lived service account keys.
prompt: Enforce Workload Identity on order-processing-cluster to eliminate static JSON credentials.

factors: Pods mounting static credential files in filesystem secrets
risk_assessment.rationale: Static keys mounted inside pods can be exfiltrated. Workload Identity provides automatic token rotation and removes persistent credentials.

technical_diff.summary: Configures Workload Identity pool on cluster.

remediation.action_title: Enable GKE Workload Identity on Production Cluster
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 4.2 recommends Workload Identity to replace long-lived static JSON service account keys.

steps: Revert workload identity configuration via container API

description: Internal database worker VM has public external IP address attached directly to interface.
prompt: Remove unauthorized external public IP from database VM db-worker-vm-01 in staging.

factors: Direct public IP attached to internal worker VM
risk_assessment.rationale: Internal database worker should not be directly routable from the public internet. Outbound traffic must route via Cloud NAT.

technical_diff.additions: + access_configs: [] # Outbound internet routed via Cloud NAT
technical_diff.summary: Deletes external IP AccessConfig from VM network interface.

remediation.action_title: Delete External Public IP AccessConfig from Compute Engine VM
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 3.8 states internal database and worker VMs must have only internal IP addresses.

steps: Re-attach external IP if needed

description: Production payment events Pub/Sub topic is not encrypted with Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMEK).
prompt: Enforce Cloud KMS CMEK encryption on Pub/Sub topic payment-events-topic-prod.

risk_assessment.rationale: High-volume transactional event streams must be protected under customer cryptographic key control.

technical_diff.summary: Configures Cloud KMS key for encrypting messages at rest.

remediation.action_title: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMEK) on Pub/Sub Topic
remediation.rationale: Secures buffered queue messages with enterprise cryptographic key.

steps: Revert topic encryption settings

description: Cloud Storage bucket permissions allow public read access (allUsers in IAM binding).
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-GCS-84920: Cloud Storage bucket retail-app-invoices-dev allows public access.

factors: Public anonymous read access enabled via allUsers
Non-production tier enables safe autonomous self-healing
risk_assessment.rationale: Although located in development, public access violates organizational security policy POL-CIS-GCP-5.1. Autonomous remediation is permitted.

technical_diff.summary: Removes allUsers IAM binding and activates Public Access Prevention (PAP).

remediation.action_title: Remove allUsers IAM Grant & Enforce Public Access Prevention (PAP)
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 5.1 mandates blocking allUsers. Enforcing PAP prevents subsequent accidental public exposures.

steps: Re-add public binding if external dev webhook fails

description: Development bucket retail-app-invoices-dev has public read access and missing lifecycle retention management.
prompt: Inspect and remediate finding group on bucket retail-app-invoices-dev (2 active violations).

factors: Atomic multi-finding resolution in development sandbox
risk_assessment.rationale: Resolving public access and lifecycle transition atomically in dev sandbox. 100% automated self-healing without human blocker.

technical_diff.additions:
+ public_access_prevention: "enforced"
+ lifecycle_rules: [ { action: "SetStorageClass: COLDLINE", condition: { age: 365 } } ]
technical_diff.summary: Enforces PAP and adds 365-day Coldline lifecycle rule atomically.

remediation.action_title: Atomic Multi-Fix: Enforce PAP & Configure 365-Day Coldline Lifecycle Rule
remediation.rationale: Cuts storage costs and closes public reading risk simultaneously.

steps: Restore original bucket configuration

description: Automated daily backups and point-in-time recovery disabled on database instance.
prompt: Remediate finding #SCC-SQL-21094: Automated backups disabled on analytics-mysql-dev.

factors: Zero downtime risk to enable background backup schedule
risk_assessment.rationale: Automated backups in dev environment ensure developer data loss prevention without requiring engineering overhead.

technical_diff.summary: Enables automated daily backup schedule at 03:00 UTC.

remediation.action_title: Enable Automated Daily Backups and Point-In-Time Recovery on Cloud SQL
remediation.rationale: Ensures developmental database states are recoverable following testing experiments.

steps: Disable automated backups if storage quota exceeded

description: User-managed service account key has been active for 142 days without cryptographic rotation.
prompt: Rotate expired user-managed service account key ci-deployer-sa-key-9281 older than 90 days.

factors: Stale credential can be rotated smoothly via Secret Manager sync
risk_assessment.rationale: Key age of 142 days exceeds the 90-day threshold. Autonomous key rotation creates replacement and deprecates stale key.

technical_diff.summary: Generates new service account key and disables expired key.

remediation.action_title: Rotate Expired Service Account Key and Sync Secret Manager
remediation.rationale: CIS GCP Benchmark 1.3 mandates rotating credentials older than 90 days to limit the impact of leaked keys.

steps: Re-enable previous key if CI/CD runner fails

description: Cloud Function has public ingress setting enabled and utilizes deprecated runtime python38.
prompt: Update ingress settings to internal-only and upgrade runtime on nightly-cleanup-function-dev.

risk_assessment.rationale: Internal utility function should not have public ingress. Upgrading to python312 and internal ingress eliminates CVE risks.

technical_diff.summary: Restricts ingress to internal VPC and updates runtime.

remediation.action_title: Restrict Ingress to Internal Only & Upgrade Runtime on Cloud Function
remediation.rationale: Hardens serverless function against direct public invocation and resolves end-of-life runtime vulnerability.

steps: Revert ingress settings via functions API

description: Resource matches 100% of defined organizational security baselines. Zero active violations detected.
prompt: Verify compliance posture on secure-backup-vault-prod.

risk_assessment.rationale: Exemplary hardened resource architecture demonstrating zero drift and flawless compliance posture.

technical_diff.additions: // Resource matches 100% of defined organizational security baselines
technical_diff.summary: Compliance Score: 100% | Zero Violations Present | Status: Fully Hardened.

remediation.action_title: No Remediation Required — Resource in Certified Golden State
remediation.rationale: Resource passes all automated controls. Continuous monitoring active.
